remarks: UTILITIES INCLUDED!!! UNIQUE AND ONE OF A KIND APARTMENT. Come and enjoy the quiet and relaxing surroundings in Westport, Ct.. This furnished one bedroom apartment has an open floor plan with vaulted ceilings. More benefits include your own driveway, attached 1 car garage and private entrance, laundry inside unit on main floor, central air, and a beautiful backyard to enjoy nature. A large bay window and several skylights let in plenty of natural light into the apartment. An open concept layout gives you a grand view of the kitchen, breakfast bar, dining area and living room. This country style living is situated close to the beach and has easy access to I-95 or the Merritt Parkway. There is one flight of stairs to get into the ranch style unit.
